evidence.quote: Language : English Language : The language of instruction is English, and applicants are required to submit proof of English language proficiency with their application.
International students from non-EU/EEA countries pay a fee of 1,500 euros per semester.
International students from non-EU/EEA countries have to pay a tuition fee of EUR 1.500 per semester

notes: The programme's own page lists the deadline as 'July 15' without a year; the DAAD page says 'until 15 July' for all countries. The tuition fee of 1,500 EUR per semester is the general rate for non-EU/EEA international students at Heilbronn University; it is not a programme-specific exception. The programme's direct page also displays 'Tuition fee: 0 €' but this appears generic/contradicts the university-wide rule and was excluded. Admission is restricted and selection criteria apply, which may include grades and experience; this should be manually checked.
